mandatory_status: Mandatory under Electrical Appliances (Quality Control) Order
description: Specifies safety, insulation, heating, and electric shock protection requirements for electric dry irons, steam irons, and travel irons for household use.
certification_guidance: Manufacturers must set up an in-house laboratory equipped for insulation resistance, earth continuity, high voltage, and leakage current testing before applying on the Manakonline portal.
important_notes: Commercial sale, distribution, or storage of electric irons without a valid ISI mark is prohibited under Central QCO notifications.
The product rating plate must display the ISI mark along with the assigned 7 or 8-digit CM/L license number.
Requires factory audit and independent lab testing of sealed samples.

product_name: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Natural Mineral Water)
mandatory_status: Mandatory under FSSAI & BIS Joint Quality Regulations
description: Prescribes physical, chemical, microbiological, and packaging standards for treated, packaged drinking water in bottles, pouches, and 20-litre jars.
certification_guidance: A fully functional in-house microbiological laboratory with a qualified microbiologist is mandatory. Water must be tested for toxic heavy metals (Lead, Arsenic, Cadmium), pesticide residues, and microbial pathogens.
important_notes: Packaged drinking water cannot be bottled or sold anywhere in India without an active BIS ISI license.
Every single batch must be tested for microbiological purity (E. coli, coliform, yeast, mould) prior to release.
Containers must display the BIS ISI Mark with the CM/L number alongside the FSSAI license number.

mandatory_status: Mandatory under MoRTH Motor Vehicles Quality Control Order
description: Covers requirements for design, construction, peripheral vision, impact attenuation, and retention systems for protective helmets used by riders of two-wheeled motor vehicles.
certification_guidance: Manufacturers must possess drop-tower impact attenuation rigs, chin-strap dynamic retention testers, and optical visor test benches for routine quality verification.
important_notes: Selling or manufacturing non-ISI certified motorcycle helmets in India is an offence under the Motor Vehicles Act.
Helmets must pass penetration and impact shock absorption criteria.
The ISI Mark must be indelibly printed or engraved on the outer shell and inner comfort liner.

product_name: Self-Ballasted LED Bulbs for General Lighting
mandatory_status: Mandatory under MeitY Compulsory Registration Order
description: Specifies safety and interchangeability requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps intended for domestic and general lighting purposes.
certification_guidance: Products must be tested at a BIS-recognized laboratory in India. The manufacturer then submits the test report online on the CRS portal to obtain an R-number (Registration Mark) under Scheme-II.
important_notes: Under Scheme-II (CRS), initial factory audit is not conducted; compliance is granted on the basis of accredited lab test reports.
The product body and retail packaging must state: 'Self Declaration - Conforming to IS 16102 (Part 1)' along with the R-number (e.g., R-XXXXXXXX).
Key tests include electric strength, cap temperature rise, insulation resistance, and resistance to heat and fire.

product_name: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars (TMT Rebars)
mandatory_status: Mandatory under Ministry of Steel Quality Control Order
description: Specifies requirements for thermo-mechanically treated (TMT) deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement in grades Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 550, and Fe 600.
certification_guidance: Steel rolling mills must possess chemical spectrometry analysis equipment, universal testing machines (UTM) for tensile/yield stress, and bend/rebend mandrels for continuous in-house quality assurance.
important_notes: Sale or import of construction steel without the BIS ISI Mark is illegal under the Steel and Steel Products QCO.
Each rebar must have rolled-in branding showing the manufacturer trademark, IS 1786 mark, and strength grade (e.g., Fe 500D) at regular intervals.
Requires strict surveillance sampling and factory compliance audits.

mandatory_status: Mandatory under Hallmarking Orders (Ministry of Consumer Affairs)
description: Specifies fineness, approved karat purity grades, assay testing methods, and laser marking standards for gold jewellery and precious artefacts.
certification_guidance: Jewellers must be registered with BIS. Assaying and laser hallmarking is performed exclusively at BIS-recognized Assaying and Hallmarking Centres (AHC) using Fire Assay (cupellation) or XRF methods.
important_notes: Hallmarking is mandatory in notified districts of India for approved gold purity grades.
Every piece must carry the 3 mandatory marks: BIS Logo, Karat Purity (e.g. 22K916), and the 6-digit alphanumeric HUID code.
Consumers can verify the jeweller registration and assay date of any piece via the BIS Care App.
